# @three-ws/herald-mcp

> Let an AI agent tell its human something in person: a 3D character walks onto the browser tab they have open and says it out loud. Announce a line, report a finished task with the right urgency, or check the rail. Account-scoped over the live three.ws API via a Bearer API key.

@three-ws/herald-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/herald-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/herald-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/herald-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/herald-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/herald-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
